description:
Ready to take your career global? 
 
 Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Software Engineer I (SDET-Java,Selenium,API) to join our ever‑evolving WPG Billing and Invoicing team and help shape the future of global commerce.
 
 
 
 What you’ll own 
 Design/Work with automation framework from scratch--Page object model design pattern with data driven framework

 Design Testing strategy and define the approach. 

 Write and execute Automation test scripts. 

 Write and execute manual functional test cases 

 Report defects and traceability with tools like Jira. 

 Collaborate with the stakeholders and give the demo
Showcase leadership qualities, proactive and ready to work on different initiatives related to Quality Improvement

 
 
 What you’ll bring 
 2-4 years of hands-on experience in test automation

 In depth knowledge & experience of automation frameworks of UI (Selenium) and API (Soap UI, Postman, Rest Assured or Karate) using Core Java

  In depth knowledge & experience in an AWS/microservices environment/testing

 Collaborate with QA/Dev team members to automate test cases (UI and API)

 Good knowledge of Payment Domain

 Have expertise in Core Java (Java 8 and above)    Have very good hands-on knowledge on creating frameworks for UI and API

 Good experience in BDD Agile methodology along with Cucumber based projects

 Good testing framework knowledge like Junit, TestNG

 Have end to end automation experience from Maven/Gradle, Git, Jenkins etc.

 Good exposure to Agile based project

 Comfortable in designing and implementing automation test scripts based on the requirements

 Knowledge of test management tools and systems – such as JIRA, Rally Confluence 

 Good Knowledge of handling stakeholder or cross-functional testing teams

 Ability to summarize / present technical information in a manner that others can understand

 
 
 About the team 
 Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have some of the best minds in the industry—people you can learn from as you grow your career.
The people, the energy, the connections—it's unmatched. Be part of an ever‑evolving company with opportunities that go beyond borders.
 
 What makes a Globalpayer? 
 Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner, and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative—always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and our passion drives excellence in everything we do.
 
 Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer.
 
 Apply now to take your career global.
 
 #LI-ALKAYADAV
